exercises.prompt: Which noun is an underived primitive noun (ism jāmid)?
exercises.explanation: شَمْسٌ is a primitive noun (ism jāmid), whereas مُعَلِّمٌ and مَكْتُوبٌ are derived participles (mushtaqqāt).

feedback.rule: Primitive nouns (jāmid) are not derived from verbal roots via participial patterns.

exercises.prompt: Match each Form I maṣdar to its typical semantic tendency:
exercises.explanation: Form I maṣādir are lexical, though فُعُولٌ, فِعَالَةٌ, and فَعْلٌ show clear semantic tendencies.
